Image 1 is the edit target and EXACT anatomy/placement template (a front-facing bald adult fashion model). Image 2 is only the original body's neck skin tone/lighting continuity reference. Image 3 is only the desired beautiful, refined semi-realistic fashion illustration style. Redesign the COMPLETE face into a very pretty Korean natural makeup look: gentle small oval face, naturally smooth U-rounded chin (not pointy V, not broad square jaw, no bulging cheeks), harmonious softly shaped brown almond eyes, delicate brown lashes, refined natural brows, a subtly rounded small nose, softly tinted peach-rose lips, warm ivory translucent skin with extremely subtle blush. Prefer attractive realistic human proportions over oversized doll eyes or a chubby baby face. Keep the subject EXACTLY front-on, eye line and gaze symmetrical, skull size, eye spacing, ear attachment and neck positioning like Image 1; keep the entire original portrait canvas and margins, no zoom/crop/shift. Ears must be anatomically clear and sharp. Draw one coherent skin surface including both cheeks, single chin and continuous neck with the same lighting/tone as Image 2: no neck seam, no duplicate chin, no cheek blobs, no rectangular skin patches. Include the full bald scalp and natural ears so independent hairstyles can be worn. No hair, no jewellery, no clothing, no shoulders, no background, no border, no text. Actual transparent background. Keep an uncut long enough neck at the lower edge to allow a gentle body blend.
